sharedScale.description: Whiskers and box boundaries use the same shared linear scale. A boundaries7/13 and median10; B boundaries6/17 and median11. B median lies halfway between10and12; B Q3 lies halfway between16and18.

annotationAssessment.pointer: The relocated pointer addresses the median value annotation. Its tip is near/touches the lower-right parenthesis of(11), without crossing either1digit or altering the median line. It is not interpreted as a second data point.
annotationAssessment.small360Callout: Very small but decipherable in the actual360px screenshot. It repeats the independently visible numeric comparison11>10, so this size limitation does not remove the mathematical information.
nonblockingLimitations: The bottom comparative callout is small at360CSSpx; no comfortable large-font or general accessibility claim is made.
Raster regions outside the annotation are visually compared, not certified pixel-identical.

currentContextAssessment: Both full current DE and EN descriptions require interpreting and comparing data from indicators/boxplots with mathematical justification, AB2/J7. The preserved five-number summaries, common scale, IQR/spread and median comparison support this illustrative task. No sample sizes, means, raw data reconstruction or assessment mastery are inferred from the plot.

currentViewportEvidence.observation: All ten numeric values, box boundaries and the unit ticks remain distinguishable. (11) and (17) are not occluded. The lower callout is very small but decipherable; its comparative text is redundant to directly visible medians11and10. Pointer ends near the closing parenthesis of(11), not across either digit.

All five-number summaries, integer ticks and three comparative callouts are readable. The pointer is adjacent to the right parenthesis of(11), while both1digits and the(17)label are clear. No label, whisker or box is clipped.
